TITLE: Trump shifts between diplomacy and threats in Iran standoff
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-21 19:11
AUTHOR: Joseph Stepansky
SOURCE: Al Jazeera

KEY:
- Trump oscillating between calls for lasting ceasefire and threats of military escalation
- Iran (as of Thursday) said had received + was reviewing Washington's response to Tehran's latest ceasefire proposal

TRUMP MIXED MESSAGING:
- Tuesday: "an hour away from making the decision" to resume attacks
- Wednesday: "We're in the final stages of Iran. We'll see what happens. Either have a deal, or we're going to do some things that are a little bit nasty, but hopefully, that won't happen"
- Wednesday: "If we don't get the right answers, it goes very quickly. We're all ready to go"
- Thursday: promised to take possession of Iran's HEU stockpile
- Thursday: again rejected Tehran imposing fees on Hormuz
- Thursday: reposted NY Post op-ed by Richard Goldberg (FDD) titled "Here's how to crush Tehran in three moves":
  - Sustain blockade and economic warfare
  - Remake world in America's energy dominance image
  - Order US military to forge path through Hormuz to restore freedom of navigation "on our terms, not Tehran's"

ON NETANYAHU:
- Trump Wednesday: "He's a very good man, [Netanyahu]'ll do" what's needed

IRAN POSITION:
- Tehran has repeatedly said US taking HEU is a "non-starter"
- Khamenei directive Wednesday: uranium must stay in Iran
